name: cinemacc-subtitle-skill
description: An auditable agent skill for repairing, translating, and validating SRT subtitles.

interface.shortDescription: Repair, translate, and QA SRT subtitles
interface.longDescription: Research title context, repair source tracks, translate for each locale, and validate SRT subtitles without silently changing cue timing.
defaultPrompt: Repair and translate this SRT into natural Simplified and Traditional Chinese.
Inspect this subtitle file and report structural, textual, coverage, and timing risks.
Compare these SRT sources and identify which evidence is safe to reuse.
